title: Rabbi Yose ben Yehoshua
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Chullin 56b, Niddah 24a and Jerusalem Talmud Niddah, chapter 3, at the end of halakhah 2. In all of them Rabbi Yochanan reports in his name. It appears that he was among the last Tannaim, who lived after Rabbi.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The post-Rabbi dating is introduced as an inference, not an independently established date.

The consulted Chullin, Niddah and Jerusalem Niddah passages support Yochanan reporting Yose ben Yehoshua; the Jerusalem form includes berabbi Yehoshua. Hyman’s suggestion about this figure’s period remains tentative, without a newly established generation or identity.
